title: Agency to Studio adapter
root_cause: Agency specialist selection and Studio governed execution are disconnected surfaces.
source_requirement: Translate Agency selection into a validated Studio execution request while keeping Studio as executor.
implementation_steps: Resolve selected specialist revision and allowed capabilities.
Bind task plan, authority, and budgets.
Submit only to the existing Studio run-control owner.
negative_cases: Authority or budget widened in translation.
affected_tests: Agent runtime and Studio run-control tests.
rollback: Remove adapter call and leave Studio/Agency prior paths unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Studio remains the sole governed executor.
